title: Kesusasteraan & Peribahasa
canDo: Understand and use common Malay proverbs (peribahasa) appropriately
Appreciate cultural nuance embedded in literature
lifeBenefit: Add colour and cultural depth to your Malay through proverbs and literary appreciation.

vocab.en: like bamboo and the riverbank (mutual support/interdependence)
vocab.example: Hubungan mereka bagai aur dengan tebing.
vocab.exampleEn: Their relationship is like bamboo and the riverbank — mutually supportive.

vocab.en: enthusiasm that fades quickly (lit. 'warm like chicken droppings')
vocab.example: Semangat dia hangat-hangat tahi ayam je.

vocab.en: family ties can't be truly broken (lit. 'water cannot be severed by chopping')
vocab.example: Walau bergaduh, air dicincang tidak akan putus.
vocab.exampleEn: Even after fighting, family ties remain unbroken.

vocab.example: Peribahasa ini menggambarkan nilai masyarakat Melayu.
vocab.exampleEn: This proverb reflects Malay societal values.

vocab.example: Penulis banyak guna kiasan dalam puisi ini.
vocab.exampleEn: The writer uses a lot of figurative language in this poem.

vocab.example: Apa mesej tersirat dalam cerpen ni?
vocab.exampleEn: What's the implicit message in this short story?

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate, using a proverb: 'Even though we argued, our family ties remain unbroken.'
practiceExercises.answer: Walau kami bergaduh, air dicincang tidak akan putus.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'This proverb describes someone whose enthusiasm fades quickly.'
practiceExercises.answer: Peribahasa ini menggambarkan seseorang yang semangatnya hangat-hangat tahi ayam.

scenario.setting: Discussing the hidden meaning of a short story excerpt in a book club

script.ms: Apa pendapat awak tentang mesej tersirat dalam cerpen ni?
script.en: What do you think about the implicit message in this short story?

script.ms: Saya rasa penulis guna banyak kiasan untuk gambarkan kehilangan.
script.en: I think the writer uses a lot of figurative language to depict loss.

script.ms: Betul, dan ada peribahasa 'air dicincang tidak akan putus' yang sesuai dengan tema keluarga.
script.en: Right, and the proverb 'water cannot be severed by chopping' fits the family theme well.

script.ms: Setuju. Ia menggambarkan hubungan yang bagai aur dengan tebing walaupun berjauhan.
script.en: Agreed. It depicts a relationship like bamboo and the riverbank, even when apart.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a thoughtful book club member discussing the hidden meaning and use of proverbs in a short story. Engage with literary nuance and invite the learner's interpretation. High, reflective register.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the book-club dialogue, focusing on reflective, literary tone and correct proverb delivery.
Discuss a short story or poem (real or invented) with the AI book-club persona, using at least one proverb appropriately.
rubric: uses a proverb correctly in context

speakingPrompts.instructions: Give a 2-minute talk explaining one proverb from your own culture, translated and compared to a Malay one from this unit.
rubric: at least one Malay proverb used correctly

questions.prompt: Translate the meaning (not literally) of: 'Semangat dia hangat-hangat tahi ayam.'
